channel.title: Lynn Group Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lynn Group Media (hoganstand.com)

item.title: "The league for us, it's about trying to unearth and blood up a couple of new players"
item.description: Dublin manager Ger Brennan says there's "no panic" within his group after falling to two defeats from their opening two games in Division 1 of the Allianz Football League.

item.title: "It's great to have him back on the pitch"
item.description: Donegal star Michael Murphy featured for the Tir Chonaill men yesterday for the first time since last July's All-Ireland SFC final defeat to Kerry.

item.title: Ladies: Royals down All-Ireland champions in Stamullen
item.description: Goals in either half from Emma Duggan and Ciara Smyth helped Meath to a comprehensive win over Dublin in their Lidl NFL Division 1 tie played at the St. Patrick's GAA club grounds in Stamullen

item.title: Ladies: McMaugh stars as Waterford make it two wins on the bounce
item.description: The teams came into the game with success on the road in Round 1 with Kerry overcoming Dublin in pretty rough conditions and Waterford having the better of Armagh.

item.title: Kiely blames ring rust for early defeat
item.description: John Kiely says his Limerick team looked 'ring rusty' in their surprise Allianz Hurling League loss to Waterford last Sunday.

item.title: Death of legendary Longford goalkeeper John Heneghan
item.description: Longford GAA is mourning the passing of John Heneghan, who was goalkeeper on the county's history-making 1966 National League and 1968 Leinster SFC winning teams.

item.title: McGuinness remains hopeful of facing Down in Ballybofey
item.description: Jim McGuinness believes Donegal's Ulster SFC quarter-final against Down could still take place in MacCumhaill Park.

item.title: No NFL game in Croker this year
item.description: American football won't be returning to Croke Park in 2026, NFL Commissioner Roger Goodell has confirmed.

item.title: McConville calls for level playing field after controversial defeat
item.description: Oisín McConville has claimed the GAA is paying lip service to teams outside the top two divisions in the Allianz Football League with regard to the new playing rules.

item.title: Ballygunner contingent ready for Waterford return
item.description: Waterford manager Peter Queally expects to have his Ballygunner contingent back for next Sunday's Allianz Hurling League Division 1A clash with Offaly.
